correctness.rationale: The sequence O(-3,-3) --F--> O identifies H1(C,O_C) with H2(P1xP1,O(-3,-3)); Frobenius is F times squaring on the four Cech monomials, producing H_(k,l),(i,j)=c_(2i-k,2j-l) over F2. Since dim=4, a=4-rank(H) and f=rank(H^4). The 16-bit mask loops really cover 65,535 nonzero sections. Geometric negatives have 49,515 explicit points over degrees 1..6 and an independent direct-substitution checker; the complement is not declared smooth from this degree cutoff. All 252 orbits of that complement undergo four-chart exact Groebner unit-ideal tests (F,Fx,Fy), which establish geometric smoothness in every extension. 72 finite-automorphism transformations preserve this property, and canonical uniqueness of the containing smooth quadric identifies their orbits with abstract F2-isomorphism classes within the family. The separate C++ mask count and Python orbit-weighted rank distribution coincide. Fresh independent four-chart exact GF2 Groebner and Hasse-rank checks of six actual orbit representatives (6150,6183,6289,10723,30857,45515) found all smooth with a<=1, including ordinary and nonordinary examples; this small replay corroborates but does not independently exhaust all 252 Groebner certificates.
